name: Narcís Monturiol Estarriol
summary: Catalan engineer, inventor, and political activist who pioneered submarine navigation with the Ictineu vessels.

name: Figueres
summary: Town in Catalonia, Spain, where Monturiol was born and studied.

name: Sant Andreu de Palomar
summary: District in Barcelona, Spain, where Monturiol died.

name: Barcelona
summary: City in Catalonia, Spain, center of Monturiol's engineering work and political activity.

name: Cadaqués
summary: Town in Catalonia where Monturiol sought refuge and conceived the Ictineu.

name: Madrid
summary: Capital of Spain, where Monturiol worked as a typesetter and later as a deputy.

name: Alicante
summary: City in Spain where Ictineu I trials were conducted.

name: University of Cervera
summary: University where Monturiol earned a degree in Philosophy in 1834.

name: La Navegación Submarina
summary: Company formed in Barcelona in 1864 to fund the construction of Ictineu II.

aliases: School of Industrial Engineering of Barcelona
name: Escuela Industrial Barcelonesa
summary: Technical institution in Barcelona whose professors supported Monturiol's projects.

name: National Stamp Factory
summary: Factory in Madrid where Monturiol served as director in 1873.

name: Ictineu I
summary: First submarine prototype designed by Monturiol, launched in Barcelona in 1859.

name: Ictineu II
summary: Second submarine prototype designed by Monturiol, launched in 1864 and fitted with a steam engine in 1867.

aliases: Essay on the Art of Navigating Under Water
name: Ensayo sobre el arte de navegar por debajo del agua
summary: Monturiol's treatise on underwater navigation, published posthumously in 1891.

name: Cigarette manufacturing machine
summary: Machine invented by Monturiol in 1866 to produce 45 cigarettes per minute.

name: Josep Missé i Castells
summary: Master boatbuilder who constructed both Ictineu vessels.

name: Josep Oliu
summary: Revolutionary colleague and crew member of Ictineu I.

name: Joan Monjo
summary: Naval architect who designed Ictineu I and participated in Ictineu II construction.

name: Josep Pascual Deop
summary: Industrial engineer who designed the steam engine for Ictineu II and married Monturiol's daughter.

name: Étienne Cabet
summary: French utopian socialist whose ideas Monturiol spread in Catalonia.

name: Damas Calvet
summary: Industrial engineer and professor who collaborated with Monturiol on chemical experiments.
